executive_summary: Analysis of 1 server(s) identified 1 failure risk(s). 0 critical and 0 high-priority issues require immediate action. Primary threats: EOS OS/software, missing HA/DR, and single-NIC exposure.

predicted_failures.description: 169.254.1.1 has a single NIC with no bonding/teaming. One NIC failure isolates the server completely.

root_causes.description: Single NIC provides no path redundancy. Any NIC failure = server unreachable.

preventive_measures.action: Add secondary NIC and configure bonding/teaming on 169.254.1.1.
preventive_measures.rationale: NIC redundancy eliminates single network path as a failure point.
